title: 4-Day Inca Jungle Trail to Machu Picchu
h1: Inca Jungle Trek to Machu Picchu 4 days

seo.title: 4-Day Inca Jungle Trail to Machu Picchu
seo.description: Combine biking, trekking, and adventure sports on an alternative route to Machu Picchu through the Peruvian jungle.

summary: Combine biking, trekking, and adventure sports on an alternative route to Machu Picchu through the Peruvian jungle.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Cusco – Downhill cycling – (cycling and rafting)
itinerary.body: On the third day, our transfer will be waiting for you at the hotel entrance at 07:00, so that later our bus will take us to Abra de Málaga. We will make a brief stop in Ollantaytambo, where you will take a short break to make some necessary purchases for the road, then we will continue the Inca Jungle trail until we reach Abra Málaga, where the guide will give you some tips and instructions to start the bike tour. We will begin the descent until we reach the archaeological center of Wamanmarca, at this place the guide will give you information about the archaeological center, you will have time to take photographs. During the trip we will make several stops to check our bicycles and equipment. We will arrive at the town of Santa María (1,200 meters above sea level), where we will have lunch and spend our first night in an Ecolodge called Bella Victoria. In the afternoon we have the option of rafting on the Vilcanota River. This river offers category III and III+ rapids. For this activity we will provide you with category V helmets, windbreakers and life jackets. This activity is available between the months of April and December, and you must know how to swim to participate, in accordance with Peruvian legislation. Overnight: Ecolodge Bella Victoria. Meals included: Lunch, dinner

itinerary.title: Day 2: Santa Maria – Santa Teresa (trekking – Cocalmayo Hot Springs)
itinerary.body: After a delicious breakfast, we will be ready to make the first day of hiking to Santa Teresa. In the first two hours of our tour we will climb the terrain. Along the way we will make several stops to learn a little more about the rich flora and fauna of the area in which we will find ourselves. We will also stop at the home of a local family, where we will learn about their customs and traditions. Later, we will cross a section of the Inca Trail that formerly connected the citadel of the Sacred City of Machu Picchu with the last Inca refuge, Vilcabamba. Here our guide will explain a little more about the history of the Incas and also about the Inca communication system (the Inca route). At this point we will have the pleasure of enjoying some of the most impressive views of the Huancarccasa canyon, the majestic Salkantay. Then we will descend to the town of Quellomayo, where we will enjoy a delicious lunch and a relaxing rest in the restaurant’s hammocks. We will continue with the last two hours of our walk to reach the Cocalmayo thermal baths, where we will spend time enjoying this charming place. When the entire group is ready, our private transportation will take you to the city of Santa Teresa, where we will spend our second night. Overnight: Hotel in Santa Teresa. Meals included: Breakfast, lunch, dinner

itinerary.title: Day 3: Santa Teresa – Aguas Calientes (Hike)
itinerary.body: After breakfast, we will head to the nearby zip line site. There we will try different zip line routes, cross a suspension bridge and do some light climbing. After this activity, we will take our transportation to go to Hidroeléctrica to have lunch and continue the walk for another 3 hours to Aguas Calientes. Overnight: hotel in Aguas Calientes. Meals included: Breakfast, lunch, dinner

itinerary.title: Day 4: Cusco – Aguas Calientes  4 Hour Trip) - 2h30m
itinerary.body: In the morning, according to the scheduled time, our guide will pick you up at your hotel to go to the bus station where you will ascend 400m along a winding path for 20 minutes to reach the incredible wonder of the world “The Historical Sanctuary of Machu”. Picchu”, also known as “The Lost City of the Incas”. Upon arriving at the citadel of Machu Picchu with our guide, we will pass through the entrance and begin the tour of the entire citadel. For around 2h30m we will visit the main places of Machu Picchu. We return to the town of Aguas Calientes in the afternoon, where you will have free time to enjoy lunch at one of the many restaurants (lunch not included). After lunch, we will take the train to Ollantaytambo (depending on the availability of the train departure time). The return will follow the same route as the departure. Upon arrival in Ollantaytambo, the train representative will be waiting to take you to the bus to your hotel in Cusco.
